description: Embed audio and video on your website.
definition: HTML can embed sound and video with native playback controls.
code:
<video controls
       src="lesson.mp4">
 Your browser needs video support.
</video>
rule: Use audio for sound and video for moving pictures.
tip: The controls attribute adds the browser playback interface.
caution: Add captions for spoken video content, and avoid relying on autoplay.
exercise: Embed a local video and show its playback controls.
